verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (brand, phone, sale ribbon, headline, offer, CTA), but the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an almost illegible speck, the legal line is enlarged nearly to the size of the offer copy, and the ribbon is small and pushed down under the phone. B also jams its logo into the top-right corner over a circle, leaves 'last' orphaned in the headline, enlarges the legal text the same way, and stretches the CTA nearly edge to edge.
